goal: Repair PR #85 so it satisfies Kolibri master canvas Prompt #3 (`P0_KOLIBRI_UNIFIED_FABRIC_API_AND_SERVER_CONNECTIVITY`) instead of only documenting the broader API surface.
objective: On a remote server, update PR #85 in-place to add tested Prompt #3 Fabric API compatibility endpoints, canonical request/response envelope helpers, deny-by-default admin safety stubs, fallback reason taxonomy tests, and exact run artifacts. Do not run implementation on Mac. Do not merge, approve, mark ready, deploy, restart services, force push, push to main, rotate credentials, or print secrets.
implementation_requirements: Reuse existing Control Plane `/health`, `/v1/nodes`, `/v1/tasks`, `/v1/tasks/{task_id}` and `/v1/tasks/{task_id}/cancel` behavior where possible.
Expose `/v1/fleet/*` aliases or wrappers over existing node/fabric-route data and include degraded nodes rather than hiding them.
Expose `/v1/agents/*` aliases over existing task control-plane endpoints with the canonical response envelope.
Add `/v1/models`, `/v1/responses` and `/v1/chat/completions` as safe OpenAI-compatible contracts/stubs that do not call external providers or print secrets.
Add `/v1/admin/*` as deny-by-default safe stubs requiring explicit auth/scope/audit; do not execute privileged actions.

Add shared helpers or equivalent tests for canonical request/response fields: task_id, trace_id, owner/source/command_node/role/target, fallback, write_scope, constraints, status, node, route_used, fallback_nodes, artifacts, blocked_reason, repair_task and next_action.
Expand fallback reason taxonomy to include api_unreachable, vpn_down, firewall, disk_full, auth_failed, dns and unknown.
Fix PR #85 documentation whitespace so `git diff --check` passes.
Keep PR #91 dependency classification: useful for broad MIMO rollout, not blocking PR #85 endpoint repair.
verification_commands: python3 -m py_compile ops/factory_control.py ops/kolibri-dispatch backend/main.py tests/test_fabric_control.py
acceptance: Remote implementation happens on a server node, not on Mac.
PR #85 branch is updated by normal non-force push only.
Required Prompt #3 endpoint surface is implemented or represented by safe deny-by-default stubs with tests.
Tests cover fleet aliases, model/responses/chat stubs, agents aliases, admin deny-by-default stubs, canonical envelopes and fallback reason taxonomy.
No unrelated product features are added.
No deploy, service restart, merge, mark-ready, approval, force-push or push-to-main occurs.

Remote result reports status, node, agent display name, branch/head, tests, artifact paths, blockers and next exact task.
